commands.name: create
commands.reason: Project creation remains a core workflow.
commands.migration: Keep using ghostinit create; V2 validates the complete desired state before writing.

commands.name: init
commands.migration: Keep using ghostinit init; V2 applies the same resolver as create.

commands.name: upgrade
commands.reason: Managed projects require a migration command.
commands.migration: Run upgrade --dry-run first; V2 changes only proven generator-owned files.

commands.name: add
commands.migration: Use the same add kinds; V2 validates kind-specific positional forms strictly.

commands.name: sync
commands.migration: Keep using sync; V2 reconciles from ghostinit.config.json transactionally.

commands.name: status
commands.reason: Humans and agents need project state visibility.
commands.migration: Keep using status; V2 reports desired, owned, drifted, and pending state separately.

commands.name: check
commands.reason: Architecture enforcement remains a first-class command.
commands.migration: Keep using check; V2 fails closed on parser, resolver, and analysis-limit errors.

commands.name: doctor
commands.migration: Keep using doctor; V2 runs only checks applicable to resolved configuration.

commands.name: version
commands.migration: No command change; JSON mode returns the versioned V2 envelope.

commands.name: help
commands.migration: No command change; help is generated from the typed command registry.

commands.name: capabilities
commands.reason: Agents need the finite proof-gated support catalog.
commands.migration: Use capabilities --json to discover supported V2 bindings before create.

options.name: cwd
options.reason: Commands need an explicit project root.
options.migration: Keep using --cwd; V2 canonicalizes and contains the path before IO.

options.name: json
options.migration: Keep using --json; consume the versioned V2 schema instead of V1 field spreading.

options.name: yes
options.migration: Keep using --yes; unresolved required choices now fail before side effects.

options.name: ci
options.migration: Keep using --ci; V2 returns a typed missing-input error instead of prompting.

options.name: dry-run
options.migration: Keep using --dry-run; V2 performs no lock, write, cleanup, install, or secret action.

options.name: force
options.migration: Keep using --force only where the command registry declares it applicable.

options.name: no-install
options.migration: Keep using --no-install; V2 still preflights the full project plan.

options.name: runtime
options.reason: Generated server execution runtime remains selectable.
options.migration: Map --runtime to the app/backend execution runtime; package manager and framework route runtime are separate.

options.name: quiet
options.migration: Keep using --quiet; JSON stdout is unaffected.

options.name: debug
options.migration: Keep using --debug; secrets remain redacted.

options.name: version
options.reason: The global version flag remains supported.
options.migration: Keep using --version.

options.name: help
options.reason: The long help flag remains supported.
options.migration: Keep using --help.

options.name: h
options.reason: The short help alias remains useful.
options.migration: Keep using -h; it resolves to --help.

options.name: kind
options.migration: Keep using --kind only on registry-declared add forms.

options.name: check
options.migration: Keep using sync --check; drift returns exit code 8.

options.name: mode
options.reason: Single and monorepo packaging remain supported.
options.migration: Keep using --mode or set mode in ghostinit.config.json.

options.name: framework
options.migration: Map --framework to the primary web app target.

options.name: billing
options.migration: Keep using --billing or set provider IDs in capabilities.billing.

options.name: features
options.reason: The combined feature string hides independent capability configuration.
options.migration: Use explicit --with-eve/--with-i18n or ghostinit.config.json; alias removal target is 3.0.0.

options.name: database
options.migration: Keep using --database or set backend.database.

options.name: apps
options.migration: Keep using --apps; V2 expands each target into an explicit app object.

options.name: preset
options.migration: Keep using --preset; the resolved config records every resulting choice.

options.name: cache
options.migration: Keep using --cache or set capabilities.cache.

options.name: deploy
options.migration: Map --deploy to the primary app; multi-app projects configure deploy per app.

options.name: stack
options.reason: Stack aliases conflate framework and app targets.
options.migration: Use --framework plus --apps or explicit app objects; alias removal target is 3.0.0.

options.name: with-auth
options.migration: Keep using --with-auth for defaults or configure auth methods/plugins explicitly.

options.name: with-api
options.migration: Keep using --with-api; V2 emits transport only when selected clients require it.

options.name: with-email
options.migration: Keep using --with-email or set capabilities.email.

options.name: with-analytics
options.migration: Keep using --with-analytics or set capabilities.analytics.

options.name: with-cache
options.reason: The cache convenience flag remains supported.
options.migration: Use --with-cache for the default verified cache or select capabilities.cache explicitly.

options.name: with-eve
options.migration: Keep using --with-eve or set capabilities.eve.

options.name: with-i18n
options.migration: Keep using --with-i18n or set capabilities.i18n.

options.name: with-pdf
options.migration: Keep using --with-pdf or set capabilities.pdf.

options.name: with-messaging
options.migration: Keep using --with-messaging or set capabilities.messaging.

options.name: fix
options.migration: Keep using --fix on check/doctor; V2 dry-run and locking rules apply.

options.name: verbose
options.migration: Keep using --verbose on registry-declared commands.

options.name: list
options.migration: Keep using add --list; values are generated from the command registry.

exitCodes.name: GENERAL_ERROR
exitCodes.reason: Unexpected failures retain the general code.

exitCodes.name: VALIDATION_ERROR
exitCodes.migration: Read structured nested details in JSON mode.

exitCodes.name: CONFLICT_ERROR
exitCodes.migration: Read structured conflict paths in JSON mode.

exitCodes.name: GIT_DIRTY_ERROR
exitCodes.migration: Operational Git errors now fail closed with this code.

exitCodes.name: INCOMPATIBLE_SCHEMA
exitCodes.migration: Run upgrade --dry-run and follow migration hints.

exitCodes.name: GENERATION_ERROR
exitCodes.migration: Read versioned plan diagnostics in JSON details.

protocols.name: json-envelope-v1
protocols.reason: V1 allowed details to overwrite protocol fields and did not redact the full error.
protocols.migration: Validate version 2, read error.details, and preserve the stable machine code/exit code.

config.name: cli-create-flags
config.migration: Flags override the desired state only where the typed command registry permits.

config.name: .ghostinit/state.json
config.reason: V1 mixed desired and internal state.
config.migration: Treat V2 state as machine-owned hashes/history only; edit ghostinit.config.json instead.

config.name: ghostinit.config.json
config.migration: upgrade --dry-run derives this file from V1 state and flags.

upgrade.name: upgrade-v1
upgrade.reason: V1 can overwrite fresh state and user-modified files.
upgrade.migration: Run V2 upgrade --dry-run; only hash-proven owned files change automatically and every conflict is reported.
